title: A resolved conflict no longer waits for the owner
what: Drop the merge rule "ask the owner before the merge when taking the default branch hit a conflict a fixer resolved by hand". The owner's word is needed only when the conflict could not be resolved (the fixer stopped on it). A resolved conflict still goes through the gate and a recheck of every rider's item before the merge.
why: Owner, 28 Oct, verbatim: "Давай уберем правило по которому ты спрашиваешь меня в случае конфликта, мое слово требуется только если ты не смог его решить самостоятельно"
pass_cases: rules/git.md, the front skill (plugins/front/skills/front/SKILL.md:113) and the delegate skill (plugins/delegate/skills/delegate/SKILL.md:204) no longer list a hand-resolved conflict as a reason to ask; they say the owner is asked only when a conflict could not be resolved.
Any code that holds a merge for a hand-resolved conflict (merge hook, cycle script) is changed the same way, with a test.
Eval cases that expect the ask are updated.
